notes: ὅτι is written out as 'that' and aligned in the ordinary way (rule 43).
The genitive and dative article–noun pairs decided by whether the ASV wrote a determiner: 'of the' anchors on τῆς, while the anarthrous κυρίου takes its own supplied 'the' (rules 21, 51).
τῷ κυρίῳ Χριστῷ split into three units rather than sharing one head (rules 26, 28).
